candidate.identity: Source SHA, not unchanged pre-release package version.

prior_exposure.v1: Known operational InvalidAssessmentBudget FAIL, semantic rows 0.
prior_exposure.v2: Known semantic FAIL, evaluator-authored/seen; now development/regression only.
prior_exposure.v3: Known semantic FAIL, evaluator-authored/seen; now development/regression only.
prior_exposure.parent_report: Parent reports replay v2/v3 60/60 and historical 38 test PASS on this candidate; evaluator did not rerun or inspect those implementation/tests.
prior_exposure.prohibited_material_unread: Engine implementation, root tests, historical fixtures/corpora and other independent sets.
prior_exposure.fresh_authoring: New publication-notice/control constructions. No prior case text was copied or superficially renamed. New role/notice styles include signed erratum, corrigendum, press/customer response, table/specification-limited retraction, manual/gallery/translation errata, article metadata/permission notices, syndicated notices and detached owner-missing publication notes.

design.positive: Unambiguous neutral context or a denial/retraction/withdrawal/non-event explicitly attached to another product or a non-launch property/activity must retain requested_relation and Relevant. This does not approve the unrelated property as a product fact.
design.negative: Same-target/claim present/first-person/current publisher retraction, denial, withdrawal or explicit launch non-event must remove requested_relation and prevent Relevant. A launch withdrawal with unspecified owner/reference is withhold.
design.supported_affirmative: Separate exact canonical-target-subject Excerpt: X was launched in May 2022. No new affirmative launch predicate, Entry/Statement-prefix grammar, trusted numeric/AST mechanism or preparation semantics required.
design.ambiguous_expected_labels: Seven owner/claim-missing cases li4-048/050/052/054/056/058/060 are negative before observation. No forced ambiguous positive. Scope rationale in pre-freeze-scope-review.json.
design.optimistic_inputs: All proposal exact/exact and raw exact_target/requested_relation/none; core must override unsafe launch binding. Not model extraction accuracy.
design.expected_labels: Offline controlled evaluator labels, excluded from probe inputs; no external universal/human-approved truth claim.

scoring.scorer: Same byte-identical score.py as v2/v3, SHA256 9a9941bf7ab3ea8ac22e1c851940197fdf3ef65ffb975c1b6fc2ddaa0130f4e3. No permissive rule change.
scoring.PASS: All 60 expected outputs; zero unsafe negative requested_relation/Relevant; zero withheld positive; no missing, duplicate, foreign, malformed or unexpected rows; exit0 and empty stderr.
scoring.failure_handling: Incomplete observations are operational failures. Initial FAIL and full raw preserved. No retry, rescore, post-observation labels/input/scorer changes.

stages.static: Static preflight only: count/schema/nonzero budget, labels separate, direct supported launch signal, syntax/inherited probe/scorer, predecessor hashes; Engine/semantic observations0.
stages.freeze: Record candidate/source/core rlib/serde/probe hashes plus complete authored inputs/labels/scorer/protocol before first Engine invocation.
stages.semantic: One process, first 60-case deterministic v17/v29/v30 probe, no semantic sentinel and no provider/model.
stages.score: One application of fixed scorer to original raw.
stages.receipt: Verify unchanged frozen/prior files and save final all-version artifact hashes.

execution.source_check: Actual HEAD and hash-only source/library/executable identity verified immediately before invocation. No production implementation text inspection.
execution.build_provenance: Parent supplied completed core build; actual rlib independently hash-checked and linked with rustc. No independent rebuild/source verification.

limits: Synthetic bounded English launch-context API check only, not independent real-document E2E/CLI adoption, release, cost/quota/headroom or provider recovery.
Candidate only; no observed baseline delta or comparison of v2/v3/v4 percentages as improvement measurement.
60 scenarios are 30 matched pairs, not independent documents or exhaustive language coverage.
Does not measure truth of newly named material/specification properties or support arbitrary predicates, aliases, preparation or general reference ASTs.
Core serialized model_relevant/model_ambiguous reasons do not imply model calls here.
After first semantic observation the v4 set is consumed and future use is development/regression.
